title: Surreal Painting Collage
description: A 2x2 grid of distinct painted panels. Top-left shows red dripping liquid over a dark background beside yellow tulips. Top-right displays lush pink and white flowers with green leaves and glowing fruit. Bottom-left features large blue spheres on a pink field next to a desert landscape with rock formations. Bottom-right depicts a dark gothic castle by water under a red sunset with a bright glowing sun.
prompt: A 2x2 grid of distinct oil paintings. Top left: red viscous liquid dripping down a black panel next to a field of yellow tulips. Top right: dense blooming pink and white flowers with glowing round fruit on branches. Bottom left: large floating blue spheres on a pink background beside a sandy desert landscape with rock spires. Bottom right: dark gothic castle with lit windows beside a reflective river under a dramatic red sunset with a bright glowing sun, painterly fantasy style.
